_comment: Copy to fintechlab.json beside your runner (or name it with FINTECHLAB_CONFIG).
Every field is optional. The environment wins over the file:
FINTECH_SIM_LAB_URL, FINTECH_SIM_LAB_TOKEN (or the lab's own LAB_API_TOKEN), RUNNER_ADVERTISED_URL, RUNNER_BROWSE_URL.
lab_url is the lab API: registration, the clock and the lab hooks all go there. lab_token only when the lab asks
for one -- better in the environment than in a file. console_url and clock_url are for a lab without the lab API.
stand_ins: per lab stand-in, connected (its vendor wiring live) and shown (its card visible).
An absent id or field leaves it as the lab has it. Keys starting with _ are comments.
